name: navigation-menu
blurb: Radix-based navigation menu with keyboard support and animated content viewport.
description: Composable wrapper around Radix UI's NavigationMenu primitive. Exports NavigationMenu, NavigationMenuList, NavigationMenuItem, NavigationMenuTrigger, NavigationMenuContent, NavigationMenuLink, NavigationMenuIndicator, and NavigationMenuViewport. Handles keyboard navigation and focus management automatically.
use_when: Building accessible navigation menus that must support keyboard interaction and screen readers, especially for complex site hierarchies.
avoid_when: Simple flat menus where a basic select or tabs would suffice. Overkill for minimal navigation.
a11y: Full keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Enter, Escape). Proper ARIA attributes and focus management via Radix primitive. Works with screen readers.
